description: This file defines a Drupal 7 comment source plugin class for migrating comments from the database, including methods for querying, preparing data rows, and defining fields.

classes.name: Comment
classes.description: A Drupal 7 comment source plugin class for migration, extending FieldableEntity, with methods for querying, row preparation, and field definitions.

methods.name: query
methods.description: Builds and returns a database query to select comment data joined with node data, ordered by creation time.

methods.name: prepareRow
methods.description: Prepares each data row by setting properties, handling translation, and replacing subject with field value if applicable.

methods.name: fields
methods.description: Returns an array describing the fields available in the comment source.

methods.name: getIds
methods.description: Defines the primary key for the source data, which is 'cid'.
